description: Slab of black volcanic glass, faceted and chipped. It sheds off a Magmashell's plates as the fire cools.
lore: Ground flat and worked with wet sand for a week, a slab this size is a mirror, and a dark one — it takes about a third of the light out of whatever it shows you. The trade knows to sell them outdoors at noon. Indoors by a candle, everyone looks like the end of a long year.

The buyers are mostly old, and there is a use for a mirror in a country where [[lore/the_quiet|the stages]] are only ever learned from outside: you look, daily, and you check that the face doing the looking is one you can still put a name to. An elder on the east road bought a slab, brought it back the following morning and asked for his money. The seller said the glass was accurate. The elder said yes, that was the complaint.
